describe: Bright pastel blue-lavender sci-fi cityscape at dawn: a futuristic glass-and-chrome skyline with domed towers and spires on the left and right, a large glowing circular portal / energy ring behind the boy on the far left, soft green treetops along the mid-right, faint pastel planets (a ringed Saturn-like planet and two small moons) drifting in the upper sky with scattered white stars, and a polished reflective tiled plaza floor with pale violet highlights running across the bottom third. Boy Aarav in a blue jacket with orange backpack fist-bumps the white-and-blue robot Nova on that plaza.
